title: Typography / Hierarchy with the logotype
slide_intent: Separate headline from signature through weight and scale because equal-looking elements can compete for the same reading role.
strategic_value: A light DIN headline contrasted with the Duolingo signature can preserve both message hierarchy and brand recognition.
demonstration: Ideal and maximum examples compare headline scale with the logotype; the copy specifies light weight and 1.5× versus 2× x-height relationships.
practical_value: Check headline weight and scale when DIN is paired with the signature.

content_islands.name: Scale comparison
content_islands.spec: Keep the Ideal and Maximum examples side by side within the left panel.

content_islands.name: Hierarchy instructions
content_islands.spec: Place the heading, light-weight direction and numerical relationship in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says contrasting weight and scale creates a harmonious relationship between logotype and headline.
reference_purposes.Application: Ideal and maximum specimens show the relationship.
reference_purposes.Constraint: DIN should be light when paired with the logotype; ideal scale is 1.5 times its x-height, with 2 times as the maximum.

ingredient.name: Headline-to-logotype hierarchy
ingredient.application: Pair the logotype with light DIN Next Rounded; target 1.5 times the logotype x-height and do not exceed 2 times.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical rule for DIN used with the logo, not a universal headline/body ratio.
